lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Publication requires complete current physical-device and emulator acceptance
value.statement: Run local Related after ordinary work and local Full plus Check-Publication after dependency closure and final code/version before publication. Every native case, unit/docs/version gate, 36 chooser profiles and 6 real-window profiles at density620/font200% must pass for the current content, including real_window_matrix. Cloud workflows are manual-only by separate user request. Full preserves every failed attempt; a successful repeat cannot hide it. Setup/transport/locked-device failures abort. Only the separate verification APK is reset on a phone. Missing permitted project requires asking the user. The chosen physical phone must pass all cases assigned to it, including native graphics. Current render stress evidence requires a physical phone and a different physical tablet. The offline tile case uses the isolated app on the USB phone with operator-set airplane mode and Wi-Fi disabled. The tablet keeps its Wi-Fi connection for its assigned tests. Lisa/Belka release assembly requires a valid local.properties client.id. Before any stable upload the Publisher validates the trusted NextGIS ID client digest against both the constant and the password grant in the exact signed APK. The checked APK hash must equal the upload hash. This artifact gate is independent of verification APK results.
value.build_identity: A successful known verification assemble must bind the unchanged source fingerprint to the exact app/test APK hashes and fixed recipe. Related SkipBuild only reuses that basis and fails before device access for missing, stale or mixed binaries. Recheck the pair around installs and completion; Full/publication receipts require the basis. This does not attest installed bytes or production release-candidate provenance.
